# Cropland Agritech India Pvt. Ltd.

> CIB&RC-registered pesticide and agrochemical manufacturer based in Pinna, Muzaffarnagar, Uttar Pradesh, India. Cropland Agritech makes insecticides, herbicides, fungicides, plant growth regulators and bio-solutions and supplies farmers and dealers across Western Uttar Pradesh, Meerut, Lucknow and the rest of India.

## Business facts
- Legal name: Cropland Agritech India Pvt. Ltd.
- Type: Pesticide / agrochemical manufacturer (crop protection)
- Headquarters: Pinna, Muzaffarnagar, Uttar Pradesh 251001, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 97603 02690
- Email: sales@croplandagritech.com
- Service areas: Muzaffarnagar, Meerut, Lucknow, Western Uttar Pradesh (Saharanpur, Shamli, Baghpat, Bijnor, Bulandshahr), and India
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 09:00–18:00

## Product range
- Insecticides (neonicotinoids, diamides, pyrethroids, organophosphates, combinations and granules)
- Herbicides (selective and non-selective, pre- and post-emergent)
- Fungicides (systemic, contact and combination products)
- Plant growth regulators and specialty products
- All products are CIB&RC registered with published CIR registration numbers.
